summary: I have over 10 years of professional service in Information Technology Support and Technical Operations in working with the Federal Government and private sectors. I have a broad knowledge and expertise in strategic planning, IT Business Systems, Network Operations, IT Security and System Analysis. My goal is to secure permanent employment within an outstanding organization that offers opportunities for growth and advancement, while implementing a high degree of professionalism, enthusiasm, and initiative on a daily basis.

experience.title: Information Technology Specialist/System Analysis
responsibilities: Served as IT System Analyst for the Department of the Army, improving business processes and configuring Microsoft Outlook 2013.
Monitored network availability and performed maintenance to support Army users.
Collaborated with Joint Service Provider, IT Agency, DISA, and Video Teleconference Team to deliver IT services.
Developed and implemented an IT asset management program.
Managed Verizon service contracts using CPARS and WAWF.
Handled IT issues via Remedy ticketing system.
Coordinated technical assessments and cost estimates for life‑cycle replacement.
Prepared documentation for complex systems and maintained business continuity plans.
Managed copier and printer inventory.
Acted as Entitlement Manager for DoD Enterprise Email, creating distribution lists and managing permissions.
Analyzed and tested new IT equipment.
Migrated ISDN and VOIP telephone systems for over 1,500 users.
Provided desktop support across multiple operating systems.
Conducted information assurance and security training.
Advised the CIO on security vulnerabilities and developed countermeasures.

experience.title: Information Technology Specialist/Network Administrator
